|translation='''Title:''' Chewie.

'''Card text:'''
Deploys only on Hoth. After that, he can move anywhere. However, he cannot deploy if three or more of the opponent’s unique (*) characters are on the table.

'''Lore:'''
Captain Han Solo’s loyal Wookiee companion. Co-pilot of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Leia calls him a “walking carpet.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card uses an asterisk for the uniqueness mark in the title and the corresponding reference in the game text.
